question: Can retained paired ANS convert directly to the existing bit-plane resident without HDF5 rereads, within 1-2 seconds for seven acquisitions, preserving exact detector maps?

parameters.conversion: two-pass direct ANS decode into block32 bit planes; reuse exact DPC summaries; host prefix only compact length index

artifact_results.single-baseline: Dynamic private array: 1.355 s conversion, 0.309 s GPU measure, 0.794 s write; 3 maps and 11 DPs exact. Single exploratory run.
artifact_results.single-low-width: Fixed low-width registers: 1.062 s, 0.313 s measure, 0.617 s write; same parity checks. Single exploratory run.
artifact_results.seven-vector: Fixed vectors: 6.476 s summed conversion with parity between sources, 21 maps and 77 DPs exact. Not continuous seven-source wall timer.
artifact_results.seven-contiguous: 6.578 s wall including source acceptance/read/release; 6.573 s summed conversion. 12.046 GB final packed residency, 13.029 GB maximum post-conversion Metal sample (not true peak). 21 full maps and 77 DPs exact to ANS. Early/mid cancellation and zero budget rejection pass. Target 1-2 s refuted; no native UI or independent full original-HDF5 oracle.
artifact_results.synthetic-parity: 524288 source counts exact across plain/compact offsets and reversed detector permutation; zero, constant, raw16, sparse, compact, entropy models 82 and 84-93; high values 32767,32768,65535; unknown/interleaved mode rejected. Not exhaustive entropy/malformed coverage.
